title: Protocol to generate endothelial cells, pericytes, and fibroblasts in one differentiation round from human-induced pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Prepare coating of 6 well plates by adding 1 mL of vitronectin solution to each well and leave at 17°C–22°C for 1 h.
Bring E8 medium and versene to 17°C–22°C by leaving on the tabletop for 15 min.
Wash cells once in 2 mL PBS/well when iPSC culture reaches 80% confluency.
Add 1 mL versene/well and incubate for 5 min at 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Swirl or gently tap the side of plate to detach cells.
Transfer 80 μL of cells along with versene solution to each well of a new 6-well plate precoated with vitronectin.
Add 2 mL of E8 medium including 5 μM of Rock inhibitor to each well.
Prepare 2-3 plates (12–18 wells) for the differentiation set.
Begin the APEL2 differentiation process on day 2 when iPSC cultures have small colonies and a density of 10%–20%.
Remove E8 medium from iPSC on day 1.
Add 2.5 mL of day 1–3 differentiation medium to each well for days 1–3.
Keep the plate in a 37°C incubator until day 3 without changing medium for 48 hours.
On day 3, prepare day 3–7 medium and warm it up to 17°C–22°C.
Remove the medium from the plate on day 3 by swirling it before removal to remove most of the floating cells.
Replace with 2.5 mL of day 3–7 medium at day 3.
Wash cells once with 2 mL PBS per well on day 7.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE to each well on day 7.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 37°C incubator after adding TrypLE.
Use P1000 pipet to gently detach cells and incubate another 5 minutes.
Collect cells in a 50 mL conical tube containing 10 mL MACS buffer to stop TrypLE.
Wash wells with MACS buffer and add to the cell suspension.
Make the total volume 45 mL by adding more MACS buffer to include cells from 12–18 wells.
Filter the cell solution through a 20 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 100 g.
Remove the supernatant and tap the tube to dislodge the cell pellet.
Add 5 mL MACS buffer including 5 μM Rock inhibitor per equivalent cells from one well of a 6-well plate.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 100 g.
Remove the supernatant and tap the tube to dislodge the cell pellet.
Add MACS buffer, Rock inhibitor, and FcR blocker (from CD31 microbead kit) to mix well with the cells.
Add anti-CD31 microbeads to the cell solution and pipette to mix or gently vortex.
Incubate the microbead-cell solution for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Add 20 mL of MACS buffer for washing approximately 1 × 10^7 cells equivalent.
Filter through a 20 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge for 5 min, 100 g.
Set up the magnetic station, LS separation column, and 15 mL conical tubes below the column during centrifugation.
Add 2 ml of MACS buffer to wash the column.
Remove supernatant after centrifugation and tap the tube to dislodge the pellet.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml of MACS buffer including 5 μM Rock inhibitor for less than 2 × 10^9 cells.
Load cells on top of the LS column.
Collect CD31− flow through of cells.
Add 3 ml of MACS buffer to the column and collect the first wash of cell flow through leading to a total of 6 ml of cell solution.
Change to new conical tube and wash two more times with 3 ml of MACS buffer, discarding these two washes.
Detach the LS column from the magnetic station and put above a new conical tube labeled CD31+ cells.
Add 2 ml of EGM2 medium or MACS buffer including 5 μM Rock inhibitor to the top of the LS column.
Immediately flush out the medium to collect CD31+ cells.
Centrifuge CD31− cells and resuspend in 1 ml of EGM2 medium per column eluted, including 5 μM Rock inhibitor.
Take 10 μl of cell solution and mix with 10 μl of trypan blue to count live cell number.
Plate 1 × 10^4 CD31+ cells/cm² on fibronectin-coated flasks in CD31+ EGM2 plating medium (7.5 × 10^5 cells/T75 flask).
Plate 2 × 10^4 CD31− cells/cm² on gelatin-coated flasks in CD31− EGM2 plating medium (maximum plating density 1.5 × 10^6 cells/T75 flask).
Change the medium of CD31+ cells with iEC complete medium including VEGF, bFGF, and CTGF next day after MACS.
Change medium every 2 or 3 days for CD31+ cells.
Expand induced endothelial cells (iEC) prior to cryopreservation.
Plate CD31+ cells onto fibronectin-coated culture plates and expand for 5-7 days, considered as passage 0 (P0).
Cryopreserve the cells until they are needed for an experiment.
Thaw cells at passage 1 (P1) and continue to passage when necessary, but do not pass beyond P3.
When CD31+ iEC reach near 80%-90% confluency, wash cells in 10 mL PBS.
Remove PBS and add 5 mL of TrypLE.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 37°C.
Tap the side of flasks to detach cells.
Observe under a microscope and incubate another 5 min if some cells are still attached.
Collect all cells in 5 mL iEC complete medium per flask to stop TrypLE activity.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 100 g.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of iEC medium per harvested flask.
Count the cell number and plate into new pre-coated flasks with fibronectin solution or cryopreserve, using a density of 5 × 10^5 cells/75T-flask.
Centrifuge cells for 5 min, 100 g.
Tap the flask to dislodge the pellet and resuspend in CryoStor with a density of 1 million/mL.
Label as passage number 0 (P0).
Distribute cell solution into cryovials at 1 mL/vial.
Freeze cryovials in Mr. Frosty or equivalent freezing container at -80°C.
Move frozen cells to liquid nitrogen tank the next day for long-term storage.
Thaw cells in a 37°C water bath for 2 min.
Transfer cell solution into a conical tube with 10 mL of iEC complete medium added slowly and agitated frequently.
Centrifuge for 5 min, 100 g.
Resuspend the pellet in iEC complete medium containing 5 μM rock inhibitor.
Plate 1 million cells (1 vial) into 2 T75 flasks precoated with human fibronectin.
Change to iEC complete medium next day and every 2 or 3 days thereafter.
Change EGM2 complete medium the day after plating CD31− cells from MACS.
Repeat changing EGM2 complete medium every 2–3 days until confluence is reached in 4–5 days.
Wash cells with 10 mL PBS.
Add 5 mL of TrypLE to detach cells.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 37°C.
Tab the side of flasks to detach cells.
Collect detached cells in 10 mL Pericyte differentiation medium and centrifuge for 5 minutes, 100 g.
Resuspend cells in Pericyte differentiation medium with 5 μM Rock inhibitor.
Count cells and plate 1–2 million cells per T75-flask or maintain a 1:1 ratio.
Mark the passage as P1.
The next day, change to 15 mL of Pericyte differentiation medium without Rock inhibitor per 75T flask.
Change medium every 2–3 days thereafter.
Replate CD31− cells onto a gelatin-coated cell culture plate at high density.
Passage cells 3–4 days after plating into pericyte differentiation medium.
Prepare pericytes in Pericyte expansion medium up to passages 4–5.
Change the medium for pre-pericyte (P1) cells when they are confluent in 5-7 days.
Wash cells with 10 mL of PBS and add 5 mL of TrypLE.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Tap the side of flasks to detach cells.
Collect detached cells in 10 mL Pericyte expansion medium and centrifuge at 100 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in Pericyte expansion medium containing 5 μM Rock inhibitor.
Count cells and plate 0.75–1 × 10^6 cells per T75 flask.
The next day, change the medium to Pericyte expansion medium without Rock inhibitor.
Change the medium every 2 or 3 days.
After 7 days of culture from previous passage (P2) or when cells reach 80-90% confluency, wash once with 10 mL PBS and add 5 mL TrypLE.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Tap the side of flasks to detach cells.
Collect detached cells in Pericyte expansion medium and centrifuge at 100 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL Pericyte expansion medium per T75 flask harvested.
Count the cell number.
Plate cells into new pre-coated flasks with gelatin solution at a density of 5 × 10^5 cells per 75T-flask or cryopreserve when necessary.
When cells are 80%–90% confluent, wash once in 10 mL PBS and add 5 mL of TrypLE.
Incubate for 5 min at 37°C.
Tab the side of flasks to detach cells.
Collect cells in Pericyte expansion medium and centrifuge for 5 min at 100 g.
Resuspend in 1 mL of Pericyte expansion medium per 75T flask harvested.
Count the cell number.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 100 g.
Tap to dislodge the pellet and resuspend in CryoStor with a density of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Distribute cell solution into cryovials, at 1 mL/vial.
Freeze in Mr. Frosty with isopropanol or equivalent freezing container at -80°C.
Move the vials to a liquid nitrogen tank the next day for storage.
Coat T75 flasks with 0.1% gelatin solution when thawing iPCs.
Thaw frozen vial(s) rapidly in a 37°C warm water bath within 2 min.
Transfer 1 mL of cell solution into conical tubes with 9 mL of Pericyte expansion medium (total 10 mL).
Centrifuge for 5 min at 100 g.
Resuspend in 10 mL of Pericyte expansion medium including 5 μM Rock inhibitor.
Plate 1 vial to 1 T75 flask (1 × 10^6 cells/flask).
Change medium to differentiate iPC to iFibroblasts when cells are between passages 2-5 and 70% confluent.
Wash iPC in 10 mL PBS and add 5 mL of TrypLE two days after changing the medium.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes and tab the side of flasks to detach cells.
Collect detached cells in FibroLife medium and centrifuge for 5 minutes, 100 g.
Count the cell number and plate iPC into a new T75 flask with density of 1 × 10^6 cells/ 75T-flask in 12 mL of FibroLife medium including 5 μM Rock inhibitor.
Mark as P1 and change medium the next day to FibroLife without Rock inhibitor, changing every 2 or 3 days thereafter.
Repeat passage with density of 5 × 10^5 cells/75T flask in 12 mL of FibroLife medium including 5 μM Rock inhibitor.
Mark as P2.
Wash P2 cells once with 10 mL PBS.
Add 5 mL of TrypLE to detach cells.
Collect detached cells in FibroLife medium.
Centrifuge cell suspension for 5 minutes at 100 g.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of FibroLife medium per 75T flask harvested.
Count the number of cells.
Plate iPC into a new uncoated T75 flask with a density of 5 × 10^5 cells per 75T-flask in 12 mL of FibroLife medium including 5 μM Rock inhibitor.
Mark the plated cells as P3.
Cryopreserve iFibroblasts after 2–3 passages in Fibroblast fate to ensure this fate is stabilized.
Resuspend iFibroblasts at 1 × 10^6 cells/mL in CryoStore CS10.
Distribute 1 mL of resuspended iFibroblasts into each cryovial.
Freeze cryovials in Mr. Frosty with isopropanol or equivalent freezing container at -80°C.
Move frozen vials to liquid nitrogen tank the next day.
Thaw a frozen vial rapidly in a 37°C warm water bath for up to 2 minutes.
Transfer cells into conical tubes by slowly adding 9 mL of FibroLife medium with frequent agitation (total volume 10 mL).
Centrifuge at 100 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of FibroLife medium containing 5 μM Rock inhibitor.
Plate 1 vial into 2 T75 flasks.
The next day, replace medium with 12 mL of FibroLife medium without Rock inhibitor.
